title: Tank or tankless water heater

parts.label: Water heater
parts.looks: A tall round tank (or a wall box for tankless) with a data plate, cold and hot pipes on top.
parts.abnormal: Water around the base, rust at the bottom seam or fittings.

parts.label: Temperature and pressure relief valve
parts.looks: A brass valve with a lever, on the top or upper side, with a pipe down to near the floor.
parts.abnormal: Dripping or wet discharge pipe, crust at the outlet, an outlet that is capped.

parts.label: Gas control and thermostat dial
parts.looks: The box with a temperature dial near the bottom of a gas tank.
parts.abnormal: Soot or scorch around it or the burner access.

parts.label: Flue (vent pipe)
parts.looks: The pipe on top of a gas tank going to the chimney or wall.
parts.normal: Seated on the draft hood, joints together.

parts.label: Expansion tank
parts.looks: A small round tank on the cold pipe above the heater.

parts.label: Drain valve
parts.looks: A hose-thread valve near the bottom of the tank.

faults.name: No hot water
faults.evidence: Caller's words; the camera can show the data plate (fuel, age) but not the cause.

faults.name: Tank leak
faults.evidence: Water at the base with no other source visible above it.

hazards.label: Vent pipe disconnected
hazards.threshold: A visible gap between the vent pipe and the draft hood, or a separated joint, on a gas water heater.

hazards.label: Scorch at the burner access
hazards.threshold: Black scorch or melted parts around the burner access or gas control.

hazards.label: Combustibles at the heater
hazards.threshold: Paint, fuel, rags or boxes against a gas water heater.

must_not: Relight a pilot or operate the gas control.

tour.open: Show me the water heater from the floor to the pipes on top.

checkpoints.hint: Look at the upper side of the tank for a brass valve with a pipe going down.
Tilt up to the pipe on top of the heater.
